name: pciutils
description: Collection of programs (lspci, setpci) and libpci library for inspecting and manipulating PCI devices, using hwdata's pci.ids database.
build: cd pciutils-3.13.0 && make $MAKEOPTS PREFIX="$PREFIX" SHAREDIR="$PREFIX/share/hwdata" ZLIB=no SHARED=yes
install: cd pciutils-3.13.0 && make install install-lib DESTDIR="$DESTDIR" PREFIX="$PREFIX" SHAREDIR="$PREFIX/share/hwdata"
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
